Boldklubben Fremad Amager is a Danish professional football club based in the district of Amager Vest, Copenhagen. The club's senior men's team play in 2nd Division, the third tier in the Danish football league system. The club have primarily played their home games at Sundby Idrætspark since the stadium's inauguration in 1922.
